(1) HOL is a practical, powerful, and useful tool for formal reasoning about distributed algorithms; (2) it is possible to build an infrastructure for reasoning about distributed algorithms in HOL; and (3) it is possible and useful to reason about distributed algorithms at a high level of abstraction using the powerful intuitions about events and causality.

(1) the HOL system is a useful and powerful tool for verifying distributed algorithms; and (2) the verification process for distributed algorithms is greatly simplified by using a formalism for reasoning about events and causality.

the HOL system provides the right environment for the verification of distributed algorithms, that the use of the event-based model of distributed computation provides a powerful and intuitive way to guide the proof of correctness, and that the proof of correctness of a distributed algorithm can be carried out in an efficient and systematic fashion.
